card.name: Mid-list spots before numbers and codes
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and word endings in the middle of a technical item, just before the next number or code. Examples are a comma in a list of CYP enzymes, a space before a digit, and the end of aspartate before aminotransferase.

card.writes: It suppresses paragraph breaks and end-of-text, so the text keeps going instead of ending. It mildly promotes section-label words like Example and Figure.
card.plain: It marks places where a list or phrase is clearly still going, so the text should not stop or break.
